verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never publishes actual rate-limit values or explains how limits scale across usage tiers. One item notes that the Anthropic Messages endpoint shares the 'same ... rate limits' without stating them, and the standby 429 behavior, dedicated capacity and model-feed context limits are adjacent features rather than documented rate-limit tiers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production
